about: The starter effects (S6.01): any account takes one with no upload, as it takes a starter item. Each is one of Effekseer's CC0 samples in samples/, worn at the point named; the core bundles it with its files and this declaration when it starts (apps/core/src/items.ts, readEffectStarters).
